attributes.action: An elected government needs to keep its prime minister for a minimum of 3 years
attributes.additional_details: Future general elections political parties upon taking government should be made to offer a £10m bond that if they by no fault change their leader for convenience within the first 3 years of a 5 year government they forfeit the bond and are required to go to a general election within 6 months of appointing a new leader. Stop all these self seeking politicians -have a serious contract with consequences with the electorate. 5 prime ministers in 4 years we are a laughing stock.

rejection.details:
We cannot understand from the text of your petition exactly what you are asking for.

We do already have a number of petitions open on matters relating to Prime Ministers and elections which you may wish to sign:

https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions?state=open&q=prime+minister

This one in particular may be pertinent:

The removal or death of a PM should trigger a general election
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/760199
